task: CI roadmap 1.4: re-record every visual baseline once
method: npm run test:visual ran twice on Windows. Every capture was compared with its approved baseline and between the two runs, full-mode and lite-mode captures of the same fixture were compared, and the Linux (WSL) captures were compared with the Windows ones. The maintainer reviewed a sheet of baseline, capture, and change map for each capture with changed pixels before the baselines were replaced.

changedPixels.cause: Stale baseline: test 5 read 'Cancelled as expected: This is a test', which the current fixture cannot print. Cancellation resolves with null (docs/API.md), and the new capture reads 'Cancelled as expected: null'
Seeded drawing noise (setNoise( 25, 5 )) renders slightly different values than when the baseline was approved; the pixels over tolerance are flood-fill edges moved by the noise
Color values differ by at most 3; not visible

encodingOnly.note: Identical pixels; only the PNG encoding bytes differed. Re-recorded so every baseline is byte-identical to a current capture

checks.liteMatchesFull: all 20 lite captures byte-identical to the full-mode capture of the same fixture
checks.runToRun: only keyboard_commands differed between the two Windows runs (timing, CI-008); its baseline was kept
checks.linuxVsWindows: 55 of 57 captures byte-identical; inpress_01 and keyboard_commands differ (timing, CI-008)
checks.afterReplacement: Windows and Linux: all 57 captures pass, and every capture is byte-identical to its baseline except keyboard_commands
